title: v3.0.16 "Otterly Odyssey"
summary: This release adds support for the Rio hard fork on Polygon. The hard fork on Amoy is scheduled for block number 26272256, which is expected to be mined on September-11-2025 at 15:30:00 UTC . This release is recommended only for Amoy users or those suffering from a specific issue fixed in 3.0.16. All other users should wait for the upcoming 3.1 (to be released soon).
